Same idea, two shells — the dashboard is a DSH plugin and follows the DSH plugin convent"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ions, so it keeps its own name."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Why it exists / The pain points"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"I built it because the pain points are real."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 1 · My money lives in seven places, and checking the total means opening six pages"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"EVM assets in DeBank, SOL and staking on-chain, BTC in a block explorer, plus Binance / Bybit / Back"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"pack / OKX / Bitget — each with its own app. Checking "how much do I actually have" meant hopping be"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"tween six pages, and it was easy to miss a wallet along the way."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**This plugin puts all of it on a single screen.**"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 2 · Assets that block explorers can't see"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Some money is genuinely invisible: native Solana stake accounts (`getParsedStakeAccounts` misses the"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"m), Hyperliquid L1 staked HYPE and spot balances, exchange earn/funding accounts. None of these are "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"plain SPL/ERC-20 tokens, so ordinary tools never read them."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**This plugin digs them out and prices them into your total** — including the 12.1 SOL staked in the"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" account above and the ~318 HYPE staked on Hyperliquid."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 3 · Dust coins and phishing tokens inflate the numbers"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"DeBank lists plenty of fake tokens — ETHG, for example, is a **phishing token with a manipulated pri"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ce** that once inflated one account by $570K."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**One-click blacklisting**: every token you blacklist is removed from totals, trends and historical "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"snapshots instantly."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### 4 · "How much did I have last week?""},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Without history there's no peace of mind."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Every refresh saves the last snapshot of the day** (SQLite, deduplicated by day); over time it dra"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ws a trend line that is uniquely yours:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **A zero-dependency web dashboard, launched from a real DSH plugin.** No framework, no CDN — Pytho"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"n stdlib + vanilla JS.
- **Covers BTC / EVM / Solana / Dogecoin / Cardano / Hyperliquid L1 / CEX.** "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"DeBank's 73 chains, BTC P2SH+P2TR, native Solana staking, Dogecoin (BlockCypher), Cardano (Koios, in"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"cl. stake addresses), Hyperliquid's official API (staked HYPE + spot + perp equity + vault equity), "},{"id":"p24s5","text":"and read-only CEX keys (named `<exchange>_read`). Five exchanges are supported (Binance, Bybit, Back"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"pack, OKX, Bitget). Read-only CEX keys cover spot, OKX's funding sub-account and Backpack's futures "},{"id":"p24s7","text":"collateral account, including tokenised equities; on Bitget the spot account is summed with the real"},{"id":"p24s8","text":" futures accounts and the `S*` demo products are skipped, so play money never enters the total.
- **"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"Global filters.** Category (BTC / EVM / Solana / Dogecoin / Cardano / CEX), wallet and chain dropdow"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"ns drive every panel — total, wallet-share pie, trend, chain distribution, token table.
- **Up to fi"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"ve block explorers per wallet.** Each wallet card ends in a row of explorer icons — the provider thi"},{"id":"p24s12","text":"s app actually reads from comes first (DeBank · bitaps · Jupiter · Dogechain · Cardanoscan), then th"},{"id":"p24s13","text":"e other mainstream explorers in popularity order (Etherscan, mempool.space, Solscan, Blockchair, CEx"},{"id":"p24s14","text":"plorer, …). Dogecoin shows three and Cardano four, because that is how many credible explorers those"},{"id":"p24s15","text":" chains have. CEX rows show the exchange mark instead, since an exchange account has no explorer pag"},{"id":"p24s16","text":"e.
- **Free + paid data sources, clearly labeled.** EVM uses DeBank with two providers: paid `debank"},{"id":"p24s17","text":"-pro` (badged "PAID", with a registration link) and free keyless `debank-public` fallback; CEX rows "},{"id":"p24s18","text":"always show Binance/Bybit/Backpack/OKX/Bitget with "get API key" links to each exchange (OKX and Bit"},{"id":"p24s19","text":"get also take the key's passphrase). Each source displays when it last succeeded.
